title: Frozen release cohort and deterministic candidate repository
summary: Derive the post-P15 CoreX release cohort and build byte-reproducible package-only `1.0.0` dist archives plus Composer metadata.
why: `@plan/knowledge/research-P17-design.json` §2; D96. Hardcoded current package names can be stale after D89/D90, while every later P17 proof needs one identical artifact boundary.

include: Metadata/channel discovery; exclusion proof; deterministic export; dependency closure; local Composer repository; candidate manifest; wrong-file/path/non-determinism negatives.
exclude: Stability flip; product/test code changes; remote writes; tags/releases; fixture execution; publication authorization.

sections.title: Implementation Rules
sections.text: Use exactly the schema/CLI/rules in §2. Discover identities from executed metadata, retain distribution visibility and include every live CoreX package exactly once. Export the committed candidate source, never arbitrary dirty bytes. No `version` field or path repository.

sections.title: Code Guidance

sections.title: Validation
